dedupe_keys.name: parking two minute passenger loading zones

description: Parking — Two Minute Passenger Loading zones is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Different types of loading zones operate across the Brisbane City Council area. Loading zones are located and operate at times where there is a demand for a particular activity such as passenger loading or delivering goods. Brisbane City Council has passenger set down and pick up loading zones available across the city. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are arcgis, roads traffic and parking, spatial data, loading zone, location, motor vehicle. The portal shows 2,200 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
